title: Working with Conrad Janis and why he moved to New York
summary: He earned a living about 18 months with Conrad Janis, whom he describes as a showman, and moved to New York seeking more opportunities.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah. Yeah. Who did you work with? I worked, for about a year and a half I made a living working with Conrad Janis. Who was, he started out as a Kid Ori imitator. And I guess he's still doing it. He still has those sessions at the Central Plaza. But he was never, I don't think he was ever really seriously interested in playing any kind of jazz. I mean, he's an actor, that's his main profession and that's sort of his approach to music is that he's a showman and he'll do anything to please the crowd. I mean, he stands up there and jumps up and down and sweats and his hair falls down. He's sort of the Elvis Presley of the trombone. And the New Orleans influence is just sort of incidental. And I played with him for a while. And this was after I was out of the New Orleans Circle of influence. What year was that? Oh, I guess that was about 50 or 51, 52. Soon after returning. Yeah. How did you have to go back to New York? Uh, well, I just felt a need to get out of Chicago for a number of reasons. I hadn't done well at school and I felt I was sort of floundering around here and I thought there might be more opportunities as a musician in New York. And, uh, uh, uh, the piano player that I knew Dick Wellstead, who, uh, who incidentally is another very much New Orleans influenced musician. Although he's also, uh, I guess he's more influenced by the Harlem pianists, James P. Johnson and, uh, dear Yes, I think at some of those sessions at the Central Plaza I worked quite a lot with Danny Barker. He was a New Orleans man. And there were others too. I can't...
You said Baby Downs was in New York.
Baby Downs was there for a while. I think he had a stroke at that time. And he wasn't too active.
